name: agent-registry-demo
description: Agent Registry lifecycle demo: register an AI agent as a non-human identity, grant it to a tool, rotate it by replacement, retire it, and watch the gateway refuse it (401/403/429). Mock only: an in-process registry simulator and a tiny mock gateway. No tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
